messages:
maya_finance: Kicking off a shadow-traffic canary for the new price sheet tonight at 22:00 UTC. Goal: validate billing math and invoice parity before public rollout.
ajit_sales: 👍 what's the ramp plan / cohorts?
maya_finance: 5% shadow traffic across production read-only path, sample of heavy vs low volume customers. Will run for 48h. No customer-visible charges, just comparison against current billing.
sasha_product: Do we have grandfathering rules applied in shadow? Need to ensure any legacy customers aren't flagged.
maya_finance: Yes — shadow uses the same grandfathering flag. Config is: `pricing_experiment: { cohort: "shadow", grandfathered_tiers: ["legacy_monthly", "reserved_v1"] }` — will paste full config in the runbook.
li_engineering: Who's owning routing? I can wire the traffic to the billing simulator. Need the feature flag name.
maya_finance: Flag is `pricing_shadow_2026Q1`. We'll toggle in prod ff service at 21:50 UTC.
nora_ops: Ops FYI: alert if invoice mismatch > 0.5% for top 200 accounts. billingbot will post alerts.
billingbot: Automated check scheduled: shadow-billing-compare job will run every hour and post diffs. First run at 22:05 UTC.
carlos_revenue_ops: Vendor question: Stripe net settlement delay might make some hour-by-hour diffs noisy. Recommend comparing 24h aggregates for final decisions.
sasha_product: Legal asked about promotional overrides — will shadow include promo-exempt customers? If not, we should tag those customers to avoid false positives.
maya_finance: Good call. We'll exclude promo_exempt from sample. Adding `exclude_labels: ["promo_exempt"]` to the run config.
ajit_sales: Need an approval from finance director for any grandfathering exceptions beyond current list. @maya_finance please ping once you have 48h results.
maya_finance: Will do. Posting runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runs/shadow-pricing-203950 — contains checklists, dashboards, and canary rollback steps. ✅ 
legalbot: Noted. If results show any revenue-impacting delta > 1% we require legal signoff before roll-out.
carlos_revenue_ops: Copy. Also, if we see sustained delta in usage patterns, we should A/B test with 10% -> 25% cohorts before finalizing.
li_engineering: I'll be on-call for first 3 hours to watch latency and batch metrics.
maya_finance: Thanks team. I'll post updates in this thread and tag if manual rollback needed.
